newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Monte Paschi 1996 net profit up 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Monte Paschi 1996 net profit up 40 pct.

text.p: Italian bank Monte Paschi di Siena saw a 40 percent rise in its net profit in 1996 to 210 billion lire from 151 billion lire in 1995, the bank said in a statement.
The bank, which is controlled by local authorities, said the results referred only to its Italian operations and did not include revenues from foreign affiliates.
It said its operating resulting remained unchanged at 1.02 trillion lire.
Financial margins fell 4.5 percent to 2.22 trillion lire, while service margins rose 27.4 percent to 1.09 trillion.
Direct client deposits rose six percent to 44.58 trillion lire, while indirect deposits rose 6.5 percent to 62 trillion lire. Client loans rose 1.7 percent to 39.53 trillion lire.
